_TEMPLATE: PLACEHOLDER VALUES ONLY -- NOT REAL DATA. Copy this file, replace every value below with owner-supplied provenance, and validate it with scripts/qa/fa02_portrait_manifest.py::validate_support_annotation. Every person_id here is a fake token; no real subject has been mapped. See docs/plans/EXPERIMENT_FA02_TEXTURE_REPRESENTATIONS_2026_09_06.md for what evidence is and is not currently available.
_asset_id: Must match an asset_id in the corpus_manifest v3 registry this case is sourced from.
_person_id: Must be one of that corpus asset's person_ids. Fake placeholder below.
_native_dimensions: [width, height] of the ORIGINAL native capture, in native pixels. Not the crop.
_native_roi_xywh: [x, y, width, height] of this patch in NATIVE coordinates. Validated in-bounds against native_dimensions, and its width/height must equal the saved X/S canvas shape (no resize, no registration drift).
_native_source_reference: Path (relative to the FA-02 manifest directory) of the native capture the X/S pair was cut from. Checksummed by the harness.
_supports: Acceptance provenance for the three masks that already live in the case NPZ. This record does NOT redefine the masks; it says where they came from and who accepted them. provenance vocabulary: manual | synthetic | detector_derived | owner_approved. Only manual and owner_approved are promotable -- a raw detector output is recordable but is not an externally accepted support.

allow.reference: PLACEHOLDER: eligible-skin support, e.g. reviewer-painted mask file or review ticket ID

corrected.description: PLACEHOLDER: what was corrected in X and why (e.g. 'retoucher removed a transient blemish at frame left cheek before capture of S')
corrected.human_reference: PLACEHOLDER: who recorded the correction and where that record lives

protected.reference: PLACEHOLDER: protected mark/makeup region reference. NEVER a literal detector output -- a human decides what is protected.
protected.description: PLACEHOLDER: what is protected (e.g. 'permanent beauty mark and eyeliner edge, must not be altered')

_support_acceptance_reference: Auditable pointer to the external acceptance of these supports. An assertion with provenance -- it is not automatic proof of human acceptance.
support_acceptance_reference: PLACEHOLDER: acceptance record ID / signed review note
_annotation_source: manual | synthetic | detector_derived | owner_approved. Records where THIS annotation came from.
_reviewer: Human identifier of whoever actually looked at this patch. REQUIRED when annotation_source is owner_approved.
_review_regions: OPTIONAL small rectangles a reviewer flagged for pore / fine-hair looking. Coordinates are LOCAL TO THE SAVED CROP (not native). IDs must be filesystem-safe. Do not annotate an unresolved source as a recoverable pore.
notes: PLACEHOLDER: any context a later reader needs.
_uncertainty: OPTIONAL free text: what the reviewer was NOT sure about. Explicit observability gaps belong here.
uncertainty: PLACEHOLDER: e.g. 'cannot distinguish makeup edge from a real mark at frame right jaw; treated as protected'
